The '''Enterprise Collection''' is the 31st and final physical expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 7 July 2006. The set consists of 18 foiled promo cards covering the TV series '''Star Trek: Enterprise'''.

It was available from the Decipher online store after a long delay.

The card numbering system continues from [[All Good Things]].

Due to a production error, '''Starfleet Phaser Pistol ''' has a print error (an extra line in the lore box). This is present on all prints of these cards.

For reasons unknown, the copyright line on '''Travis Mayweather''' reads 1999 instead of 2005 as the other cards in the expansion.

[[The Continuing Committee]] released the [[Enterprise Collection Remastered (expansion)|Enterprise Collection Remastered]] virtual expansion set on 26 October 2018 giving the original expansion set new life with updated icons, game text, and high resolution images for a new era of First Edition.

==Notes==
*This set is published in 2006, but the cards have a copyright date of 2005.
*Cards were published by [[Decipher]] missing the 22nd Century icon ([[File:22nd Century.png]]). [[The Continuing Committee]] corrects this oversight when publishing errata cards for this set.
* Since the October 2014 conversion rules update, all cards except those with the [[File:Alternate.jpg|Alternate|14px]] icon have the 22nd Century icon.
